## 1. Scope and method

**FICTIONAL report, not an actual audit.** Demonstrate reporting under ORR-ASP-GEN-001 r01 for DEMO-DEC-01, as represented in ORR-REC-GEN-001 r01, and original ORR-REQ-GEN-006/007. The invented reviewer examines one scripted missing-evidence route; no real assessor competence, independence or user observation is claimed. Other requirements and operating conditions are unsampled.

## 2. Evidence and result

DEMO-E03 supplies only implementation evidence. DEMO-E04 correctly retains outcome_pending because evidence against the agreed use-outcome criterion is absent. This illustrates a control decision; the wording of a fabricated event is not proof that the control operates anywhere.

## 3. Findings, limits and confidence

Teaching finding DEMO-F01: requested closure lacks outcome evidence. In the scripted review the owner must obtain scoped outcome evidence; the decision chair must receive a sufficient review before closure. No deadline is invented. The scenario has no factual freshness or statistical confidence; it cannot support actual ISO, regulatory, technical or system-wide acceptance.

## 4. Conclusion, actions and issue

Scripted disposition: action remains open; the example demonstrates how to explain the hold. Actual implementation/effectiveness: not assessed. Actual reviewer/approver: unassigned. Record review outcome and any retest separately if genuine observations later become available; never overwrite this fiction as if it were real evidence.

## 5. Attachments and history

Evidence attachments are references to the fictional decision record and original protocol, available through the library index; no source standard or private data attached. r01: initial original report example. Preserve for learning; no approved operational report or independent assurance claim.
